comment: blacklist-clearance-vectors.json in this directory is a byte-for-byte copy of the contracts repository's
cross-language vector for the explicit blacklist Clear records (scripts/estate/testdata/
gen_blacklist_clearance_vectors.mjs). Do not edit the copy. To take a newer contracts vector, copy the file from
a newer contracts commit on main, update every field below from that commit, and replace git-objects/ with that
blacklist_status_test.go checks on every run, without a contracts clone, that the copy's sha256 and git blob id
are the ones recorded here and that the recorded commit holds that blob at sourcePath, then derives every
target's clearance address with the Store's own code. With MELUSINA_CONTRACTS_GIT_DIR (scripts/run-tests.sh) it
also checks that sourceCommit is on the contracts main line; a release or CI run fails without one.
